params.prompt: The SAME WOMAN as the reference image — identical face shape, identical eyes, identical nose and mouth, unmistakably the same person — but MUCH YOUNGER: she is now TWENTY YEARS OLD. Remove every trace of age: no lines anywhere, no shadows under the eyes, no hollowing of the cheeks; give her the full soft cheeks, taut smooth luminous skin, bright clear whites of the eyes and the plump lips of a girl of twenty. Jet-black hair with no grey, centre-parted, in one long thick braid over her shoulder. Keep her red-and-pink bandhani odhni over her head, the small gold nathni on her LEFT nostril, the red bindi, glass bangles. Fair wheat-golden Malwa complexion, radiant, quietly beautiful. She must clearly read as a girl of twenty, NOT a woman of thirty or forty. Sharp photorealistic portrait, natural window light, plain background, front-facing. No text anywhere.
